Minecraft builder reference sheet, landscape 3:2, crisp vanilla Minecraft voxel render, plain light background, no characters or animals. Two complete views side by side at the same scale: LEFT straight-on north front elevation, strictly orthographic; RIGHT three-quarter front and east-side view. Skilled human builder quality with coherent block grid, real massing and depth, projecting details, recessed framed openings, stair/slab roof verges, eaves and ridge, fences, walls, trapdoors and lanterns. Show entire lot and tower without clipping.

Site: Victorian market-town hall on a flat green 41-block-wide by 37-block-deep lot facing north onto a paved street. Symmetrical two-storey warm red brick main body, 33 wide by 17 deep, portico 4 deep. Raised grey polished andesite plinth, stone water table, white quartz first-floor string course, white quartz dentil cornice beneath eaves, white quartz quoins at every corner. Two end pavilions step one block forward at front corners. Grey slate hip roof with stone ridge, small gable dormers, two brick chimneys near opposite ends, each with dark band, slab cap and curl of campfire smoke.
Centre front: broad stone stair to portico of exactly four white quartz columns carrying white entablature reading exactly "TOWN HALL" in dark block letters, beneath slate-roofed triangular pediment with white tympanum and round voxel oculus. Behind portico: dark oak front door, glass sidelights and fanlight; above a three-light Palladian window. Square red brick clock tower directly behind pediment, white quoins, white clock face with black hands on each side, open belfry containing bronze bell, white cornice, steep verdigris copper pyramid spire and lightning-rod finial. Total tower height about 43 blocks. Tall glazed windows throughout, white quartz sills, keystone flat arches on lower storey, hood moulds on upper storey. Front lawns on either side of stairs, each with flagpole flying blue banner; lantern posts flank stair. Rear gravel garden path between two oak trees, visible where possible in right view.
